description: Defines the MiniLangRuntimeException class which extends MiniLangException and represents runtime errors specific to the Mini-language processing within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MiniLangRuntimeException
classes.description: Custom exception class thrown to indicate runtime errors during the execution of the Mini-language in OFBiz.

methods.name: MiniLangRuntimeException(String, MiniLangElement)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new runtime exception with a message and associated MiniLangElement.

methods.name: MiniLangRuntimeException(Throwable, MiniLangElement)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new runtime exception with a nested cause and associated MiniLangElement.

methods.name: getMessage()
methods.description: Overrides the getMessage method to include details from the associated MiniLangElement and its method for better debugging.
